label: Specialty Ascend full-graph-parallel inplace dual-stream baseline (sonnet-throughput, provisional)
notes: Specialty full-graph-parallel inplace dual-stream experiment (workload=sonnet-throughput). Named specialty experiment (reviewer PR #76 decision): cudagraph_mode=FULL_DECODE_ONLY + split_batch_config{enabled=true, mode=inplace_parallel, num_splits=2, enable_parallel_streams=true, enable_inplace_lazy_capture=true, inplace_split_planner_policy=largest_lower, inplace_offset_match_policy=exact, inplace_parallel_replay_policy=full_graph_parallel, inplace_offset_capture_sizes=[1,2,4,8,16,32,64], parallel_capture_sizes=[1,2,4,8,16,32,64]} + --temperature 0.0 (aclnnApplyTopKTopPCustom workaround). Hardware is Huawei Ascend 910B3 (measured on machine via npu-smi; the official public target is 910B2). This experiment does NOT participate in the default official target (official-ascend-jan-2026-v0.18.0 / 910B2); it is a provisional specialty profile and must be excluded from the public leaderboard snapshot. Engine commit is vllm-hust 9ca08a102 + vllm-ascend-hust c9560ce76 (migrated full-graph branch).
